show.description: When the past refuses to stay buried, justice becomes a deadly obsession. Dr. Rajat, a brilliant Dean haunted by the brutal murder of his girlfriend, Simran, spirals into a world of hallucinations and revenge. As he meticulously hunts those responsible, Kunal and Vishakha, the lines between reality and madness blur.
